description: MEET CODY YORK The Granite State way of life runs deep through Cody’s veins. The only son of a self-employed contractor and a speech pathologist, he was raised in a house built by his father and uncle on a dirt road in Canterbury. Growing up, he watched his parents work long hours and sometimes weekends…
